# book_checkin (Resource)

The checkin records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `object_id` (String)
- `object_type` (String)

### Optional

- `bookable_id` (String) The key of the bookable record.
- `bookable_type_id` (String) The key of the bookable_type record.
- `checkin_required` (Boolean)
- `checkin_window` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--checkin_window))
- `checkout_required` (Boolean)
- `checkout_window` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--checkout_window))
- `inherits` (Boolean) When true the rule cascades to descendant objects
- `owner_id` (String)
- `require_all` (Boolean) All booking members including the owner must register a checkin
- `schedule` (Dynamic) Optional per-occurrence schedule. When null the rule applies to all occurrences. Each entry's available flag selects allow or deny.

### Nested Schema for `checkin_window`

Optional:

- `from` (Number) Minutes before the booking start when checkin opens
- `to` (Number) Minutes after the booking start when checkin closes

### Nested Schema for `checkout_window`
